translation: (Daheng is three cun and five fen below Fu'ai. Fu'ai is one cun and five fen below Riyue (GB24). Both are four and a half cun from the abdominal midline.) Following the flank and the ribs, it joins Foot Jueyin at Qimen (LR14). (Directly one cun and a half below the nipple.) Above, it runs through the chest and diaphragm, flanking the throat, and joins the Ren meridian at Tiantu (CV22) and Lianquan (CV23), ascending to the front of the crown and ending there. (Tiantu is in the middle hollow four cun and a half below the Adam's apple (laryngeal prominence). Lianquan is the point in the center two cun above the Adam's apple.) In all there are fourteen points.
